reason: Repository presents a dsh plugin whose user-facing purpose is to provide QQ IM access to a dsh agent. The README describes QQ C2C/group chat import, command-based agent controls, approvals, and session/workspace handling, while package metadata and config show integration with QQ bot SDK plus DSH plugin wiring, indicating external messaging service connectivity.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向用户的 QQ IM 插件，用于将 QQ 私聊/群聊消息接入 dsh agent，让用户在 QQ 中与智能体交互、执行指令并处理会话与审批。
summaries.en: This plugin connects QQ private and group chats to dsh agents, letting users chat with an agent in QQ, run built-in commands, and handle approval or session-oriented workflows through chat.

capabilities: Integrates QQ IM with dsh through a bot connector
Routes inbound/outbound messages between QQ users and dsh agent sessions
Supports session/context and workspace controls via chat commands
Supports chat-based approvals and status notifications
Handles configuration for QQ bot credentials

reasons.code: README states QQ private/group chat ingress and message flow to dsh agent, including streaming responses and markdown outbound handling.
README and config examples require QQBOT_APPID/QQBOT_SECRET (or environment aliases), indicating external credential handling and network-bound bot connectivity.
Package metadata declares @tencent-connect/qqbot-nodejs dependency and DSH plugin bundle patch, confirming external service integration in runtime.
